- `wrap("aaa bbb", 7)` → `["aaa bbb"]` (exactly-width lines now fit)

The fix was a one-character change in `wrapper/wrap.py`: the greedy packing condition used `len(current) + 1 + len(word) < width`, which rejected lines that would be *exactly* `width` characters long. Changing it to `<= width` matches the documented behavior ("a line may be exactly `width` long").
